eras.title: Humble Seeds in Cha Swa (柴山的开端与命名)
eras.summary: Small Hock Chew dialect mission blossoms in rural Cha Swa, adopting the name Bethany Presbyterian Church in 1950.
eras.details: In 1902, pioneers purchased the Cha Swa site and built a thatched hut sanctuary in 1903. Expansion continued with Tanjong Pagar migrants in 1905. In 1950, the church officially registered with the Presbyterian Synod.

keyFigures.name: Rev. Zheng Pin Ting (郑聘廷牧师)
Li Yuan Jun & Huang Guo Xia

milestones.event: First thatched hut sanctuary built; Wu Zhe Mu appointed first female preacher.
Tanjong Pagar branch members migrate to Cha Swa.
Formally named Bethany Presbyterian Church under Presbyterian Synod.

eras.title: Tested in the Wilderness: Airport Relocation (搬迁与流离的季节)
eras.summary: Displaced by colonial land acquisition for Paya Lebar Airport, preserved through Rev. John Henderson negotiation.
eras.details: In 1951, Cha Swa land was requisitioned for Paya Lebar Airport. Received $1,500 compensation in 1952 but no replacement land. In 1954, Rev. John Henderson secured Kim Chuan Road lease at $23/month.

milestones.event: Land requisitioned for Paya Lebar Airport.
Leased Kim Chuan Road site at $23/month.

eras.title: Establishing Roots & Spiritual Growth (金泉路堂会的建立)
eras.summary: Dedicated new sanctuary in 1955, expanding from 50 to 220 congregants under Rev. Tan Choo-Ai.
eras.details: Sanctuary dedicated May 29, 1955. Attendance grew from 30 adults/20 kids in 1948 to 70 adults/150 kids by 1959. Participated in Five Times Multiplier Movement (1960–1970) and formed Youth and Women fellowships in 1967.

keyFigures.name: Rev. Tan Choo-Ai (陈慈爱牧师)
keyFigures.role: Remembered as Good Shepherd and Diligent Evangelist

milestones.event: Kim Chuan Road Sanctuary dedicated May 29.

eras.title: Miracle of Upper Paya Lebar Road (巴耶利峇上段的奇迹)
eras.summary: Elder Ng Swee Koon donated 20,000 sq ft land in 1975; new sanctuary dedicated on 70th Anniversary in 1983.
eras.details: In 1975, Elder Ng Swee Koon donated 20,000 sq ft land. English Service launched in 1978 led by Rev. Dunstan & Elder Ng Poh Ching. Foundation stone laid March 1, 1981. First service held Jan 2, 1983, dedicated March 12, 1983.

keyFigures.name: Elder Ng Swee Koon (黄瑞坤长老)
Rev. Dunstan & Elder Ng Poh Ching

milestones.event: Land donated at Upper Paya Lebar Road.
First service Jan 2; 70th Anniversary & Dedication March 12.

eras.title: Diversification, Modernization & Digital Pivot (现代化、多元化与数字化转型)
eras.summary: Multi-lingual growth, 2020 pandemic digital pivot, and current leadership under Senior Pastor Rev. Sim Ang Lee.
eras.details: Mandarin Service founded 1996; Youth Service founded 2011 by Rev. Timothy Hoon. Good Friday 2020 digital broadcast pivot. Rev. Sim Ang Lee became Senior Pastor in August 2022 following Rev. Serene Ang retirement.

keyFigures.name: Rev. Sim Ang Lee (沈洪利牧师)

milestones.event: YPM and Saturday Youth Service launched.
Digital broadcast pivot on Good Friday (April 10).
Rev. Sim Ang Lee becomes Senior Pastor.
